requirements.title: Korea-focused courses
requirements.sourceText: Korea-focused courses chosen from the following (9 credits) - KOR 331 - Social Science Topics in Korean Studies 3 credits; KOR 332 - Humanities Topics in Korean Studies 3 credits; KOR 426 - Structure of Korean 3 credits; AAS 217 - Introduction to Korean Culture 3 credits; AAS 247 - Modern Korea through Visual Culture 3 credits; HIS 247 - Modern Korea through Visual Culture 3 credits; AAS 321 - Korean Literature 3 credits; AAS 323 - Language and Society in South Korea 3 credits; AAS 324 - Language and Society in North Korea 3 credits; AAS 337 - History of Korea 3 credits; HIS 337 - History of Korea 3 credits; AAS 400 - Seminar in Korean Studies 3 credits; ARH 355 - Modern and Contemporary Korean Art 3 credits

requirements.title: Korean Language and Korea-related courses

rule.manualCheck: AAS 340, HIS 340, AAS 344, AAS 385, AAS 391, AAS 392 and AAS 401 count only when the topic is appropriate (the page says 'appropriate topic only'); confirm topic eligibility.

requirements.sourceText: Three courses chosen from Korean Language Courses: and/or Korea-related Courses: (9 credits) - Korean Language Courses: KOR 111 - Elementary Korean I 4 credits; KOR 112 - Elementary Korean II 4 credits; KOR 120 - Elementary Korean for Heritage Speakers 4 credits; KOR 211 - Intermediate Korean I 3 credits; KOR 212 - Intermediate Korean II 3 credits; KOR 220 - Intermediate Korean for Korean Speakers 3 credits; KOR 311 - Advanced Korean I 3 credits; KOR 312 - Advanced Korean II 3 credits; KOR 411 - Advanced Korean III 3 credits; KOR 412 - Advanced Korean IV 3 credits; Korea-related Courses: KOR 475 - Undergraduate Teaching Practicum I 3 credits; KOR 476 - Undergraduate Teaching Practicum II 3 credits; KOR 487 - Supervised Research in Korean Studies 6 credits; KOR 488 - Internship 0-6 credits; AAS 240 - Confucianism and Daoism 3 credits; AAS 300 - Intellectual History of East Asia 3 credits; AAS 340 - Topics in Asian History 3 credits (appropriate topic only); HIS 340 - Topics in Asian History 3 credits (appropriate topic only); AAS 344 - Learning of Asian Languages 3 credits (appropriate topic only); AAS 385 - Translation Studies of Asian Languages 3 credits (appropriate topic only); AAS 391 - Humanities Topics in Asian and Asian American Studies 3 credits (appropriate topic only); AAS 392 - Social Science Topics in Asian and Asian American Studies 3 credits (appropriate topic only); AAS 401 - Proseminar in Asian and Asian American Studies 3 credits (appropriate topic only); AAS 440 - Inter-Asia Cultural Studies 3 credits; ARH 203 - Arts of Asia 3 credits

requirements.label: upper-division
requirements.title: Upper-division credit requirement

rule.text: At least 9 credits must be taken in courses numbered 300 or higher.
rule.reason: Program-wide credit minimum across requirements 1 and 2; no rule type expresses a minimum-credit floor over the combined minor courses.

requirements.sourceText: Completion of the minor requires 18 credits. At least 9 credits must be taken in courses numbered 300 or higher.

requirements.label: transfer
requirements.title: Transfer and other-program credit

rule.text: Up to six credits taken in Korean Studies-related courses from other institutions and other programs may count for Korean courses with approval of the Director of the Program in Korean Studies.
rule.reason: Conditional credit allowance requiring director approval; it does not map to a specific course substitution.

requirements.sourceText: Up to six credits taken in Korean Studies-related courses from other institutions and other programs may count for Korean courses with approval of the Director of the Program in Korean Studies.

requirements.label: S/U
requirements.title: S/U credit limit

rule.text: Only one course graded with the S/U credit option may be used toward the minor requirements.
rule.reason: Limit on S/U-graded courses across the minor; cannot be checked by the existing rule types and depends on transcript grading options.

requirements.sourceText: Only one course graded with the S/U credit option may be used toward the minor requirements.
